name: wykonczymy-www
description: Marketing and lead-generation site for wykonczymy.com.pl — Payload 3 + Next on Vercel.

scripts.blob:upload: set -a && source .env && { [ -f .env.local ] && source .env.local; true; } && set +a && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx scripts/blob-upload.ts
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" payload generate:importmap && next build
scripts.db:dump: set -a && source .env && set +a && DIRECT_URL=$(printf %s "$PROD_POSTGRES_URL" | sed "s/-pooler//") && mkdir -p dumps && docker exec -i "$DOCKER_CONTAINER" pg_dump --clean --if-exists --no-comments --no-owner --no-acl "$DIRECT_URL" > dumps/dump-latest.sql && cp dumps/dump-latest.sql "dumps/dump-$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M).sql"
scripts.db:dump:local: set -a && source .env && set +a && mkdir -p dumps && docker exec -i "$DOCKER_CONTAINER" pg_dump --clean --if-exists --no-comments --no-owner --no-acl -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" > dumps/local-latest.sql && cp dumps/local-latest.sql "dumps/local-$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M).sql"
scripts.db:import: set -a && source .env && set +a && docker exec -i "$DOCKER_CONTAINER" psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" < ${DUMP_FILE:-dumps/dump-latest.sql}
scripts.db:migrate:prod: pnpm db:dump && set -a && source .env && set +a && DIRECT_URL=$(printf %s "$PROD_POSTGRES_URL" | sed "s/-pooler//") && POSTGRES_URL="$DIRECT_URL" pnpm payload migrate
scripts.db:restore:prod: pnpm db:dump && set -a && source .env && set +a && DIRECT_URL=$(printf %s "$PROD_POSTGRES_URL" | sed "s/-pooler//") && docker exec -i "$DOCKER_CONTAINER" psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 "$DIRECT_URL" < ${DUMP_FILE:-dumps/local-latest.sql}
scripts.seo:populate: set -a && source .env && { [ -f .env.local ] && source .env.local; true; } && set +a && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx scripts/populate-seo.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:int && pnpm run test:e2e
